Render the relationship in bright photographic office/material daylight with integrated physical diagram depth. Blank surfaces and open connectors only; no invented printed labels or microglyphs, numerical encodings, ticks, completed badges or guaranteed outcomes. Print approved artwork text verbatim, preserving exact punctuation. Balance distinct useful relationship diagram with clear headline and readable body; keep photography secondary to meaning.

O3-A4.headline: Ai xác nhận số liệu trước giờ chốt?
